title: Family Money, Phone and Responsibilities
ticker: if you want more money, earn it
if you want more phone time, budget it

callouts: Social planning counts within phone time

allowance.formula: Age x 2.5 per month, rounded to the nearest £5
parentsCover: School shoes if needed for school
Sports kit required for school or clubs

phone.transitionBonus: +30 minutes per day during the transition
rules: Phone time includes social planning and messaging
No TikTok, Shorts or Reels in the first hour after waking
No TikTok, Shorts or Reels in the final hour before bed
No extra top-ups in the moment
No switching to TV or laptop as a loophole
Unused daily phone time does not normally roll over

limits: Buy in advance, not in the moment after time has run out
Maximum 30 extra minutes in one day
Maximum 90 extra minutes in one week
Bought time still does not override first-hour or last-hour rules

otherScreens: Laptop and solo TV still count as entertainment
Suggested limit: no more than 1 additional hour of recreational laptop or solo TV on a normal day
Family films or shared watching can be treated separately

rewards.headline: Bonus rewards
items: Every 5 house points = 30 minutes extra phone time or £2 allowance credit
Each child gets £10 for every book plus book report delivered, provided the book is at or above their recommended reading age
The book report can be written, performed as a speech, or made as a video

points.houseReward: Every 5 house points can be exchanged for 30 minutes extra phone time or £2 allowance credit
behaviour: Wrappers, bowls or cups left around
Bags, clothes or socks left dumped
Arguing or delaying instead of doing the job
thresholds: 2 points in a week: minus 30 mins phone time next day
3 points in a week: home detention
allowanceDeductions: 4-5 behaviour points: 20% reduction from next allowance payment
6+ behaviour points: 50% reduction and family review

daily.title: Every day by 8:30pm
items: No bowls or glasses left in bedrooms overnight
Own mess cleared from shared rooms

dishwasher: Empty dishwasher each morning before lunch
Help make sure dishes are stacked after dinner
Collect stray cups, bowls and plates from shared rooms by evening check
recyclingGarden: Empty indoor recycling into main bins as needed
Water front and back gardens on agreed days
Do a quick check for outdoor clutter

jobs.rate: Suggested extra-job rate: about £8 per hour
items: Weeding or a bigger garden task: £2-£4
Sorting a cupboard or storage area: £2-£3

research.headline: Why the phone rules are tight
stats: Ofcom 2024: 4-15s averaged 8h 29m a week on video-sharing platforms
Ofcom 2024: 12-15s averaged 6h 34m a week of YouTube viewing in the home
NHS-style guidance: keep at least 60 minutes screen-free before sleep
items: Research is more concerned about compulsive, bedtime and short-form use than a single universal screen-time number
NHS-style guidance supports at least 60 minutes screen-free before sleep
APA and Surgeon General guidance support family plans, predictable boundaries and sleep protection
